name: io.github.Anddrrew/scopus-mcp
title: Scopus
description: Scopus search, author and affiliation profiles, citation data, and PlumX metrics via Elsevier APIs.

environmentVariables.name: ELSEVIER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Elsevier API key from https://dev.elsevier.com. Required for every tool except subject_classifications; data access depends on your subscription and institutional access.

environmentVariables.name: ELSEVIER_INST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Institutional token supplied by Elsevier, if available for your institution. Used alongside the API key for institutional access.
